headline: Nampa approves new food truck rules
pages:
The Nampa City Council voted 4-1 on Monday night to change the city's rules for food trucks, KIVI reported. Under the new ordinance, food trucks can operate from 6 a.m. to 1 a.m. Overnight parking and outdoor dining features are now allowed as well. The ordinance takes effect March 1. The change gives mobile vendors more flexibility to serve customers in the growing Canyon County city and could help small food businesses that do not have a storefront.
Source: KIVI
